thread:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER DUTY ALERT - INCIDENT AUTH-SPIKE-5332 (severity: high) - auth-service (prod-us-east-1) returning elevated 401 rate. Pagerduty link: <https://pd.example/INC5332>
emily.ops: seeing spike start ~09:12 UTC. inference-api v2 401s up from ~3% -> ~72% across tok-srv cluster. Noted increased latency too. Rolling back latest canary now.
maria-sec: quick heads-up: log sampling shows repeated requests using valid-looking bearer tokens but tenant_id mismatch. Also found an object uploaded to staging-logs-bucket around 09:14 UTC: s3://staging-logs/tmp/ci-log-push-2026-03-17-0914.gz — looks like a batch of raw request logs.
raj-oncall: I'm taking this pager. @emily.ops can you paste a couple of anonymized log lines and which services are returning 401?
emily.ops: sample logs (anonymized):
```
2026-03-17T09:13:21Z tok-srv INFO req_id=abc123 src_ip=45.77.22.17 method=POST path=/v2/generate auth=Bearer eyJ.. tenant_id=other-tenant status=401
2026-03-17T09:13:22Z tok-srv INFO req_id=abc124 src_ip=45.77.22.18 method=POST path=/v2/embeddings auth=Bearer eyJ.. tenant_id=other-tenant status=401
```
Looks like tokens being presented for tenants that don't match the token owner.
sre-bot: Started rollback of inference-api v2 canary (deploy-6421). Status: in_progress.
kai-support: Customer ticket INC-4321: MapleAI reporting ~20% failed requests since 09:15 UTC, customers seeing 401s and degraded throughput.
maria-sec: Hypothesis: token replay or unauthorized token sharing across tenants. Also need to investigate the staging S3 upload — if that contains request headers we need to assume potential exposure of tokens. Recommend immediate rotation of any long-lived service tokens used by inference workers and any deploy keys touched in the past 48h. Also block suspicious IPs.
tim-engineering: I'll rotate svc-infer token now and update k8s secret (secret/inference-svc) with zero-downtime rollout by creating new replicas w/ new secret then draining old ones. ETA ~10m.
sre-bot: Initiating command: ./scripts/rotate-service-token --svc svc-infer --apply -> creating new-secret inference-svc-new -> patching deployment/inference-workers
emily.ops: the s3 object filename includes "ci-log-push" and was written by a CI job that pushes job artifacts to staging. Need to validate whether that job improperly included auth headers. If it's staging-only, customer risk may be low, but we must verify.
maria-sec: legal please join. If tokens were in the file, we need to treat as potential data exposure and follow notification processes.
legal: On it. Need list of affected customers and confirmation whether any active production tokens are present. @kai-support please assemble impacted-customer list and timestamps.
raj-oncall: Handing off: I'm on until 11:30 UTC. Current action items (owner): 1) rotate svc-infer token and update k8s (tim-engineering) 2) block IP ranges seen in logs (netops) 3) collect impacted customer list + notify per process (kai-support/legal) 4) preserve logs/artifacts for forensics (emily.ops) 5) ensure rollback is healthy (sre)
netops: Blocking IP range 45.77.22.0/24 at the edge WAF and edge LB for prod-us-east-1. Rule applied for 1h, will extend if necessary.
emily.ops: preserved forensic snapshot: s3://forensics/incident-5332109876/snapshot-2026-03-17-0918.tar.gz (contains anonymized copies + original object). Created IAM audit trail export as well.
sre-bot: Rollback complete. inference-api v2 canary reverted to deploy-6419. Error rate down to ~2% in last 3m.
kai-support: Customer update drafted and sent to impacted customers; majority report service restored. Ticket INC-4321 updated with steps taken and ETA for full report.
maria-sec: Recommend follow-ups: 1) rotate any other long-lived tokens created in last 72h, 2) audit CI job that pushed logs to staging for accidental header inclusion, 3) add validation to log-push to strip Authorization headers, 4) add detection rule for tenant_id/token mismatch anomaly.
raj-oncall: Closing notes for this thread: immediate containment actions completed (rollback, token rotation in progress, IP block, forensics snapshot). Support/legal to decide customer notifications if PII/tokens confirmed. Please open follow-up tasks in #incidents and tag me for the postmortem. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
